domains.label: Customers
domains.description: Customer profile, contact and billing details, addresses, and customer login accounts.

domains.label: Insurance quotes
domains.description: Insurance quote requests, available options, generated quotes, and request status history.

elements.name: public.addresses
elements.role: Stores customer street, city, and postal-code address details.

elements.name: public.customerinfos
elements.role: Stores customer identity details and links to separate contact and billing addresses.

elements.name: public.insuranceoptions
elements.role: Stores insurance offer options, including deductible amounts, currency, start date, and name.

elements.name: public.insurancequoterequests
elements.role: Records a customer's insurance quote request, selected option, request date, related quote, and policy identifier.

elements.name: public.insurancequoterequests_status_history
elements.role: Associates insurance quote requests with their status-change history entries.

elements.name: public.insurancequotes
elements.role: Stores quoted premium and policy limit amounts and the quote expiration date.

elements.name: public.requeststatuschanges
elements.role: Stores dated status changes for requests, constrained to the defined request and quote lifecycle statuses.

elements.name: public.user_logins
elements.role: Stores customer login credentials, email, and authorities.
